airports.description: Airport route network template (120 nodes, 240 edges)

tiers.numeric: single numeric range (BETWEEN or LOWER THAN … OR GREATER THAN)
tiers.categorical: single categorical IN [...] or boolean IS TRUE
tiers.two_clause: two conditions joined by AND or OR (incl. node-OR-edge)
tiers.nested: three or more conditions, nesting and/or binary NOT
tiers.paraphrase: wording does not match the property name; needs a mapping
tiers.impossible: no property in the graph can answer it; correct = no query

items.question: Show genes with at least 50 ADPKD literature references.
items.gold: (Node filters::Literature evidence::ADPKD literature evidence BETWEEN 50 AND 911)

items.question: Select nodes whose ADPKD genetic association score is 0.5 or higher.
items.gold: (Node filters::Genetic associations::ADPKD genetic association score BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1)

items.question: Which edges have at least 10 ADPKD literature associations?
items.gold: (Edge filters::Literature associations::in ADPKD BETWEEN 10 AND 726)

items.question: Genes with a log2 fold change of 2 or more in large cysts.
items.gold: (Node filters::Bulk TX data::Large cysts [log2FC] BETWEEN 2 AND 9)

items.question: Find genes expressed at 100 nTPM or more in healthy proximal tubular cells.
items.gold: (Node filters::Expression in healthy::Proximal tubular cells [nTPM] BETWEEN 100 AND 5465)

items.question: Genes whose medium-cyst log2FC is below -1 or above 2.
items.gold: (Node filters::Bulk TX data::Medium cysts [log2FC] LOWER THAN -1 OR GREATER THAN 2)

items.question: Show nodes whose coarse subcellular location is the nucleus.
items.gold: (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Nucleus])

items.question: Select secreted or membrane proteins (coarse location).
items.gold: (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Secreted, Membrane])

items.question: Which genes negatively modulate apoptosis?
items.gold: (Node filters::Mechanisms::apoptosis IN [modulates negative])

items.question: Genes involved in cAMP signaling.
items.gold: (Node filters::Mechanisms::cAMP signaling IN [involved in])

items.question: Which genes does tolvaptan interfere with?
items.gold: (Node filters::Drug interference::tolvaptan IS TRUE)

items.question: Show all protein-protein interaction edges.
items.gold: (Edge filters::Physical interactions::Protein-protein interaction IS TRUE)

items.question: Membrane proteins (coarse location) with at least 20 ADPKD literature references.
items.gold: (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Membrane]) AND (Node filters::Literature evidence::ADPKD literature evidence BETWEEN 20 AND 911)

items.question: Genes affected by metformin or by atorvastatin.
items.gold: (Node filters::Drug interference::metformin IS TRUE) OR (Node filters::Drug interference::atorvastatin IS TRUE)

items.question: Nuclear genes (coarse location) with a large-cyst log2FC of at least 1.
items.gold: (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Nucleus]) AND (Node filters::Bulk TX data::Large cysts [log2FC] BETWEEN 1 AND 9)

items.question: Protein-protein interaction edges with at least 5 ADPKD literature associations.
items.gold: (Edge filters::Physical interactions::Protein-protein interaction IS TRUE) AND (Edge filters::Literature associations::in ADPKD BETWEEN 5 AND 726)

items.question: Highlight genes with an ADPKD biomarker score of at least 50, together with edges that have at least 50 ADPKD literature associations.
items.gold: (Node filters::Biomarker annotation::ADPKD biomarker score BETWEEN 50 AND 288) OR (Edge filters::Literature associations::in ADPKD BETWEEN 50 AND 726)

items.question: Genes that play any role in both Wnt signaling and ERK1-ERK2 signaling.
items.gold: (Node filters::Mechanisms::Wnt signaling IN [involved in, modulates, modulates positive, modulates negative]) AND (Node filters::Mechanisms::ERK1-ERK2 signaling IN [involved in, modulates, modulates positive, modulates negative])

items.question: Secreted proteins (coarse location) that are affected by neither atorvastatin nor pravastatin.
items.gold: (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Secreted]) NOT ((Node filters::Drug interference::atorvastatin IS TRUE) OR (Node filters::Drug interference::pravastatin IS TRUE))

items.question: Genes with at least 10 ADPKD literature references, excluding nuclear ones (coarse location).
items.gold: (Node filters::Literature evidence::ADPKD literature evidence BETWEEN 10 AND 911) NOT (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Nucleus])

items.question: Edges with at least 3 ADPKD literature associations that are not protein-protein interactions.
items.gold: (Edge filters::Literature associations::in ADPKD BETWEEN 3 AND 726) NOT (Edge filters::Physical interactions::Protein-protein interaction IS TRUE)

items.question: Membrane proteins (coarse location) with a log2FC of at least 1 in either large or medium cysts.
items.gold: (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Membrane]) AND ((Node filters::Bulk TX data::Large cysts [log2FC] BETWEEN 1 AND 9) OR (Node filters::Bulk TX data::Medium cysts [log2FC] BETWEEN 1 AND 8))

items.question: Genes with any role in apoptosis or in the inflammatory response, but not located in the nucleus (coarse location).
items.gold: ((Node filters::Mechanisms::apoptosis IN [involved in, modulates, modulates positive, modulates negative]) OR (Node filters::Mechanisms::inflammatory response IN [involved in, modulates, modulates positive, modulates negative])) NOT (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Nucleus])

items.question: Which genes are the most talked about in ADPKD papers? Give me the ones mentioned 100 times or more.
items.gold: (Node filters::Literature evidence::ADPKD literature evidence BETWEEN 100 AND 911)

items.question: Which proteins does the vasopressin V2 receptor antagonist act on?
items.gold: (Node filters::Drug interference::tolvaptan IS TRUE)

items.question: Show me the targets of the SGLT2 inhibitors.
items.gold: (Node filters::Drug interference::dapagliflozin IS TRUE) OR (Node filters::Drug interference::empagliflozin IS TRUE)

items.question: Which genes go down in the biggest cysts?
items.gold: (Node filters::Bulk TX data::Large cysts [log2FC] BETWEEN -3 AND 0)

items.question: Which proteins end up outside the cell?
items.gold: (Node filters::Subcellular location::SubLoc coarse IN [Secreted])

items.question: Which genes help forecast how the disease will progress? Use a cutoff of 10.
items.gold: (Node filters::Biomarker annotation::ADPKD prognostic biomarker score BETWEEN 10 AND 59)

items.question: Show the edges where the two proteins physically bind each other.
items.gold: (Edge filters::Physical interactions::Protein-protein interaction IS TRUE)

items.question: Show genes located on chromosome 16.
Genes with a CRISPR knockout essentiality score above 0.5.
Edges with a STRING combined score above 700.
Routes that are at least 5000 km long.
items.gold: (Edge filters::geo::distance_km BETWEEN 5000 AND 17148)

items.question: Routes with an average delay of at most 5 minutes.
items.gold: (Edge filters::ops::avg_delay_min BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

items.question: Routes with a flight count of at most 14 or at least 61.
items.gold: (Edge filters::traffic::flight_count LOWER THAN 14 OR GREATER THAN 61)

items.question: Airports in Africa.
items.gold: (Node filters::geo::region IN [Africa])

items.question: Airports with a high bio risk level.
items.gold: (Node filters::health::bio_risk_level IN [high])

items.question: Airports in the Indian time zone.
items.gold: (Node filters::geo::zone IN [Indian])

items.question: European airports with a high bio risk level.
items.gold: (Node filters::geo::region IN [Europe]) AND (Node filters::health::bio_risk_level IN [high])

items.question: Routes with at least 80 flights that are at most 1000 km long.
items.gold: (Edge filters::traffic::flight_count BETWEEN 80 AND 113) AND (Edge filters::geo::distance_km BETWEEN 177 AND 1000)

items.question: Airports in Oceania or Asia.
items.gold: (Node filters::geo::region IN [Oceania, Asia])

items.question: Show North American airports plus every route of at least 10000 km.
items.gold: (Node filters::geo::region IN [North America]) OR (Edge filters::geo::distance_km BETWEEN 10000 AND 17148)

items.question: Routes with at least 30 flights that are either at most 1000 km long or delayed by 60 minutes or more on average.
items.gold: (Edge filters::traffic::flight_count BETWEEN 30 AND 113) AND ((Edge filters::geo::distance_km BETWEEN 177 AND 1000) OR (Edge filters::ops::avg_delay_min BETWEEN 60 AND 90))

items.question: Routes of at most 2000 km that are not operated by airline ET.
items.gold: (Edge filters::geo::distance_km BETWEEN 177 AND 2000) NOT (Edge filters::carrier::airline IN [ET])

items.question: Low bio risk airports outside Africa and Europe.
items.gold: (Node filters::health::bio_risk_level IN [low]) NOT (Node filters::geo::region IN [Africa, Europe])

items.question: Which connections cover more than 8000 km?
items.gold: (Edge filters::geo::distance_km BETWEEN 8000 AND 17148)

items.question: Which routes are the busiest, with 100 or more flights?
items.gold: (Edge filters::traffic::flight_count BETWEEN 100 AND 113)

items.question: Which routes are flown by KLM or Air France?
items.gold: (Edge filters::carrier::airline IN [KL, AF])

items.question: Which airports pose the smallest biosecurity threat?
items.gold: (Node filters::health::bio_risk_level IN [low])

items.question: Airports handling more than 10 million passengers a year.
Routes with average ticket prices under 100 euros.
